fluff.overview: ComStar organized its military forces around a combined-arms doctrine that valued infantry as an essential element of the Level I through Level VI command structure, with conventional platoons serving alongside BattleMechs, armor, and aerospace assets at every echelon. Mechanized hover platoons are among the fastest conventional infantry formations fielded, using hovercraft transports that can cross water and open terrain at speeds that wheeled and tracked vehicles cannot match. ComStar favored hover-mechanized infantry for rapid response assignments where speed of deployment outweighed the need for heavy protection. Carrying infantry-portable machine guns that provide sustained suppressive fire, these troops anchor defensive positions with a volume of fire that discourages enemy movement in the open.
